mechanism: Amphotericin B causes renal dysfunction and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that increase simvastatin's myopathy risk; simvastatin is also metabolized by CYP3A4 which may be affected by amphotericin B's systemic effects.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; consider alternative antifungal or statin; if concurrent use necessary, use lowest simvastatin dose and monitor for muscle symptoms; maintain normal potassium and magnesium levels.
